info.name: University Bus Tracker
info.description:
The **University Bus Tracker** API collection provides a set of endpoints for managing and querying university bus schedules and fleet information.

It covers the following operations:

- **Route Management** – Retrieve all available bus routes serving the university.
    
- **Schedule Queries** – Fetch bus schedules filtered by direction, including buses heading to the university and buses departing from it.
    
- **Bus Management** – Create, update, and delete bus entries in the system.
    

This collection is intended for developers building or testing a university transportation system, enabling full control over bus data and real-time schedule lookups.
